lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I wanted your opinion on something.
You don't have to be so formal.
The way you speak is a bit awkward...

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: But I enjoy speaking this way.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If that's how you feel, there's nothing I can do about that.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I like how I speak.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: May I continue?
Go ahead.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Something called a sauna has been a hot topic of conversation lately.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Have you heard of it?
A sauna?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: People go inside an intensely hot and humid room,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: and use heated stones to boost the temperature inside

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: and sweat out all toxins from their bodies.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I heard it's being used as a new military training exercise.
Who told you that?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Signal.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Perhaps, was I misinformed?
You're spot on about how a sauna works, but...

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: And on top of that, if you're well-trained,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: once you're done sitting in the sauna, you immediately plunge yourself into ice-cold water

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: to strengthen your body.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I figured there might be some benefits to this training,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: so I wanted to hear what you thought about it.
I see.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Do you think it could potentially pose any benefits?
First, let's experience it ourselves, and then talk about it.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: A man of action, not words.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Very well, I'll prepare myself.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Should I prepare ammunition for a medium-scale mission?
Please, just bring yourself and nothing else.
